Huh... That's a good way for a man to die.\nLet's take him back to base and give him a proper burial.\n<wait>
Well, in any case, it's not like moping's gonna bring him back!\nLet's get going!\n<wait>
The demons should calm down now that their leader is dead.\n<wait>
Kamikawa. We will not let your death go to waste.\n<wait>
Time to go! The leader's gotta hear about this!\n<wait>
